description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small green rectangular item with a red end, and a wooden toy saw with a blue handle off to the right. The left hand reaches in to pick up the green item and holds it steady while the right hand lifts the toy saw, brings it over to the green item as if making a careful insertion or removal motion at its end, then pulls the saw away and sets it back down while the left hand releases the green item onto the bed.
